llm.guidance: Before installing, note that this is a deprecated persona pack and new installs are directed to the successor. The included scripts are limited to local package verification, but the separate LYGO-MINT verifier link is another tool with its own behavior and should be reviewed independently before use.
llm.summary: This is a small deprecated persona helper with limited local reference files and no evidence of hidden execution, credential access, exfiltration, or destructive behavior.
